## Animation and code side by side

Unlike `.explain-manim`, this construct keeps its layout panel on the website:
the panel holds the animation and the code, while the prose sits below it at
full width, so neither column can be stretched by the text.

::: {.explain-code-manim}
```{.python .manim}
from manim import *


class DefaultTemplate(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.next_section("tree")
        self.next_section("deep")
```

```{.go}
func minimax(b *Board, depth int) int {
	if depth == 0 {
		return score(b)
	}
	return best(b, depth-1)
}
```
